tool_material: Machined tooling or a validated precision printed/sealed tool; ordinary coarse FDM finish is not sufficient evidence for the 0.10 mm cover target.
process: Compression mold around the formed steel insert. Wet the open cavities with degassed Dragon Skin 10 Slow before closing; excess leaves through the two small foot-level overflow channels. Trim flash outside the pressure face after cure.
limits: Nominal tooling geometry only. Fit actual formed steel, inspect mold alignment and verify cast wall/cover thickness before loading.
The silicone must be compatible with the actual tool, sealer and release agent. Use the manufacturer's small-scale cure/adhesion test.
The thin retaining lip has a small demolding undercut; its release and tear behavior require the first casting trial.
